title: Box Office no Hisaab: Laalo, one year since the first ₹100 crore Gujarati film
concept: First Reel on FX layer v1 (29 s): the official poster swings in as a 3D card on frame one under '₹50 lakh → ₹100 crore'; one year ago this week; no stars, a first-time director; an empty hall that fills seat by seat; a count-up to ₹100 crore and a growing bar against Chaal Jeevi Laiye's record; confetti ask 'Which film is the next Laalo?'. Why share: a proud Gujarati-cinema number story people forward to the friend who says Gujarati films don't run. Aim: comments (film names) and shares.
tags: none verified for the Laalo team; @mention none
sources: DeshGujarat 30 Nov 2025 (₹100 crore after 51 days), ThePrint (₹50 lakh budget, no big names, ₹120 crore by day 104), Deccan Chronicle (first-time director Ankit Sakhiya, no takers on release), Pinkvilla/Koimoi (beat Chaal Jeevi Laiye), Wikipedia (official poster)
